test_write_frequency_parsing: test HonchoClientConfig.from_global_config parses write_frequency strings, integers, and host overrides from a JSON config file
test_resolve_session_name: test HonchoClientConfig.resolve_session_name resolves session names with title, manual override, peer prefix, and strategy fallbacks
test_save_routing: test HonchoSessionManager.save() routes flushes immediately for turn mode, queues for async mode, and throttles for integer frequency
test_async_writer_lifecycle: test HonchoSessionManager async writer thread starts on async mode, retries failed flushes, and shuts down cleanly
test_flush_all_and_shutdown: test HonchoSessionManager.flush_all() drains cached sessions and async queue, and shutdown() joins the async thread
